name: mcpindex-gate
summary: mcpindex gate - the in-path trust-to-act client for MCP tool calls, from mcpindex.ai (the MCP server index). The config-wire install wires a proxy that posts nothing; the Python SDK wrapper posts credential-blind call receipts by default (MCPINDEX_RECEIPT_INGEST_ENABLED=0 to disable).
author: mcpindex.ai
